---
title: "Nairaland threads and views plot"
author: Casey Breen
---

Summary: Create figure with cumulative Nairaland family-life threads in the
analysis corpus (panel A) and cumulative views of those threads (panel B),
2005-2018. The corpus is every scraped thread (all seven family-life title
domains), so the count matches the denominators used in the post-level
analyses (Rmds 12-14).

```{r}
## Library packages
library(here)
source(here("code", "helpers.R"))
```

## create plot

```{r}
## analysis corpus: scraped threads in the four censused domains (family size,
## childbearing, family planning, parenting cost) -- matches the methods text
scraped_tids <- read_csv(here("data", "nairaland", "prep", "posts_complete.csv")) %>%
  distinct(tid) %>% pull(tid)

## cumulative threads + views by thread creation year
cum <- read_csv(here("data", "nairaland", "prep", "threads_analysis.csv")) %>%
  filter(thread_id %in% scraped_tids,
         fertility_core | d_parenting_cost == 1,
         year >= 2005, year <= 2018) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), v = sum(n_views, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(cum_threads = cumsum(n), cum_views = cumsum(v) / 1e6)

paper_style <- list(
  cowplot::theme_cowplot(),
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2005, 2018, 1)),
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "none"))

cum_threads_plot <- ggplot(cum, aes(x = year, y = cum_threads)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkblue") +
  geom_point(size = 3, stroke = 1, shape = 21, color = "darkblue", fill = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = if_else(year %% 2 == 1 | year == 2018,
                                scales::comma(cum_threads), NA_character_)),
            vjust = -1.5, size = 4, color = "darkblue", na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cumulative threads") +
  ylim(0, 720) +
  paper_style

cum_views_plot <- ggplot(cum, aes(x = year, y = cum_views)) +
  geom_line(color = "#CC6600") +
  geom_point(size = 3, stroke = 1, shape = 23, color = "#CC6600", fill = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = if_else(year %% 2 == 1 | year == 2018,
                                sprintf("%.1f", cum_views), NA_character_)),
            vjust = -1.5, size = 4, color = "#CC6600", na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Cumulative views (millions)") +
  ylim(0, 4.8) +
  paper_style

nairaland_threads_views_plot <- plot_grid(cum_threads_plot, cum_views_plot, ncol = 1, labels = "AUTO")

## Save plot
ggsave(plot = nairaland_threads_views_plot,
       filename = here("figures", "nairaland_threads_views_plot.png"),
       height = 8, width = 7.3, bg = "white", dpi = 300)
```
